items.title: FCA issues warning over unauthorised entity Mobile Savings Plan
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has published an official warning against Mobile Savings Plan, advising UK consumers to avoid dealing with the firm.

items.title: Chancellor John Healey expected to reverse planned cut to cash ISA allowance
items.summary: According to The Guardian, chancellor John Healey will reportedly scrap his predecessor's planned reduction of the annual cash ISA limit from £20,000 to £12,000 in his upcoming budget.

items.title: San Francisco startup Harbor seeks London capacity for AI agent insurance
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, managing general agent Harbor is in talks with London market partners to secure underwriting capacity as it prepares to insure autonomous artificial intelligence agents used by businesses.

items.title: Jeremy England Lee moves to Lockton Re Bermuda as Chairman
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, lockton Re has appointed Jeremy England Lee as Chairman of its Bermuda office to expand senior capabilities on the island.

items.title: Insurance sector appointments at OAK Global, Open GI, Fortegra and Qlaims
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, firms across the UK insurance market announce senior appointments in underwriting, technology, reinsurance and claims.

items.title: LRQA acquires Hong Kong-based Omega Compliance
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, uK-based assurance and cybersecurity provider LRQA has expanded its Asian supply chain capabilities by purchasing Omega Compliance.
